title: Negative control: two structural bounds under one description
description: The arity failure on the rationale axis, in the state a real change would leave behind. Both bounds are attributed - the x-authority map has an entry keyed by each - and both are structural, so under the rule this file was written against the whole subschema was justified by one sentence of prose: 'the envelope is bounded' licensed the 1 and the 4096 alike, and nothing could check which sentence covered which number. Both entries must be reported, by keyword. It is never loaded as a real schema.
